payload.summary: Dictionary handover: 333 sense drafts and 28 definition rewrites await clinical sign-off
payload.detail: The 2026-09 handover landed as an unpublished editorial draft layer (src/data/dictionary-sense-drafts.json, src/data/dictionary-definition-reviews.json). All 333 senses are clinicalApproval pending and publicationAllowed false, and assertNoDraftIsPublished keeps them that way. All 96 definition-review baselines hash-match the live entries, so the 28 proposed rewrites apply cleanly - none is applied because none is signed off. Evidence coverage is the governing fact: 206 of 1,881 statements carry a source and none of the 292 safety warnings does. Nothing publishes until a named clinician signs records off, and a public route for sense ids does not exist yet. See docs/dictionary-editorial-drafts.md.
